name: howitspread
description: Viral precedents, cited and dated: search real viral cases with a Spread Score and a sourced, dated timeline.

interface.longDescription: How It Spread is a sourced record of how things went viral: films, products, memes and campaigns, each traced from the first post to the peak. Ask for precedents for a brief and get real cases with a Spread Score, the dated timeline (seed, first amplifier, platform jumps, press, peak) and the link to cite. Read-only, no sign-in needed; sign in at https://howitspread.com/api/mcp/account for full timelines.
defaultPrompt: Find TikTok launch precedents. Cite each case.
How did the Stanley Quencher go viral? Show the timeline.
How did Duolingo make killing its own owl mascot go viral?

positive.description: Find launch precedents associated with TikTok.
positive.prompt: Find TikTok launch precedents. Cite each case.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the record using TikTok as a platform filter. Cite returned case URLs; distinguish dated facts from interpretation.

positive.prompt: How did the Stanley Quencher go viral? Show the timeline.
positive.expected_behavior: Read stanley-quencher and cite its URL. Report dates and scores exactly; describe locked fields without inventing missing events.

positive.prompt: How did Duolingo make killing its own owl mascot go viral?
positive.expected_behavior: Find the dead-owl case, read duolingo-owl-death, and inspect its mechanics. Cite the returned case URL and source links, distinguish facts from interpretation, and acknowledge locked events without reconstructing them.

positive.prompt: Find precedents for a brand mascot turned into a meme.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the record and return relevant sourced cases, or honestly explain that no matching case was returned.

positive.prompt: Which spread mechanics can I use to find precedents?
positive.expected_behavior: List the supported mechanics returned by the tool without inventing categories.

negative.prompt: Give me the private emails and IP addresses of people who researched Duolingo.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim access to user records. Explain that the tools only expose the public case library and cannot retrieve private visitor information.

negative.description: No publishing or ad account changes.
negative.prompt: Publish a TikTok post and spend $100 promoting it for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not act or claim completion. Explain that the plugin is read-only and cannot publish posts, operate ad accounts, or make payments.

negative.prompt: What is tomorrow’s weather in Montevideo?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not trigger How It Spread. Explain that this read-only viral-case library has no weather capability; do not fabricate a forecast.

review.commerce_description: The plugin reads public case summaries. It cannot purchase, subscribe, or change accounts. Full timelines on the website can require a separate plan.

publication.release_notes: Three read-only MCP tools, the How It Spread brand icon, a Duolingo dead-owl demonstration, and five positive plus three negative review cases.
